_about: What this release changes on purpose (tests/golden/run.py; owner decision 2026-10-27): the pages (by their pages.json url and options) that may differ from the base, the action traces (by key, with the reason) whose SQL, return or rows may differ, and the hook / admin-post / shortcode / REST names it adds. Everything else must stay the same. Empty for a move-only release; emptied again by the next release.

actions.approvals:withdraw_close: Q1: a withdraw locks the levels before the request (the same two UPDATEs in the other order)
actions.approvals:reassign_waiting: Q5: the steps a cover holds are counted under the manager they wait for
actions.approvals:reassign_move: Q5: the steps the old manager's cover held move to the new manager
actions.approvals:reassign2_move: Q5: new scenario (the new manager's cover takes them)
actions.approvals:selfadmin_admins_override: Q4: an administrator may decide their own request on a level waiting for administrators
actions.approvals:_rows:steps: Q1, Q4, Q5: rows follow the changes above
actions.approvals:_rows:requests: Q4, Q5: rows follow the changes above
actions.approvals:shutdown_deferred: Q4: the level an administrator decided is no longer told to the administrators at the end of the page
